what: Assessment A (design review) of SV Tech homepage completed — research only
why: Captured key findings of the design review for later reference before any implementation decisions.
learned: Design system is coherent in main sections but breaks at form modal states (white/gray/blue/green/red palette, text-white on cyan vs DESIGN.md rule), services present 6 equal choices with no prioritization, projects/services gated on mobile behind duplicated generic 'Ver más', MENU lacks Clientes/Contacto, project modal has no CTA, footer has English 'Home' and dead text items.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: Delivered structured findings: specificity verdict (category-generic, partial), heuristic scores (21/32), cognitive load HIGH (4 checklist failures), emotional journey (peak-end failure at success modal), 3 strengths, 5 priority issues with P1-P2 severity and fixes, persona red flags for Jordan/Riley/Casey, minor observations, provocative questions.
